description: MAPA_SINTESE_VULNERABILIDADE_EOLICAS is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Gradiente de sensibilidade do meio para receber impactos de atividades de geração de energia eólica. Leva em conta aspectos do meio ambiente que têm interface com os principais impactos da atividade, segundo levantamento realizado pela equipe da USP participante do projeto MAP. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are map, síntese, eólica, empreendimentos, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
